parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-08 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 225.6 | 4.98 | 4.98
2 | 217.6 | 7.63 | 12.61
3 | 626.8 | 19.10 | 31.71
4 | 694.3 | 0.32 | 32.03
5 | 580.5 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as Q-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-08
Curve type: Q-type
Aquifer depth: 12.61 – 31.71 m
Recommendation: Target the high-resistivity layer between approximately 12.6 m and 31.7 m depth as the primary drilling interval, as it corresponds to the thickest and most resistive unit (likely coarse sand/gravel); confirm lithology with drill cuttings and consider a pilot hole to verify saturation before final casing design.
